predictions.articleTitle: Subiza vs Pamplona Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Scoring Asymmetry at Sotoburu
predictions.coreRecommendation: Subiza are projected to secure a home victory at Campo de Sotoburu, anchored by a 2:1 primary scoreline and their 1.91 goals-per-game league offense.
possibilityAssessment: Primary 1X2 Thesis: Subiza Home Win driven by 1.91 goals/game output and unbeaten Sotoburu home record versus 15th-placed Pamplona (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Total Goals & BTTS Angle: Over 2.5 goals and BTTS Yes aligned with Subiza's 3.36 combined goals-per-game league profile and 1.45 conceded rate (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Alternative Margin Angle: 2:0 Home Win if Pamplona's 0.73 goals-per-game attack fails to breach Subiza's territorial control (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Subiza's 1.91 home-led attack tests Pamplona's 0.73-goal survival setup.

btts.comment: Subiza score at an 80.6% Poisson rate against Pamplona's 19.4% clean-sheet projection, while Subiza's 1.45 goals conceded per match leave Pamplona a 66.4% scoring window.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Subiza's home attacking edge paired with their 1.45 conceded rate, while 2:0 covers a clean-sheet home win if Pamplona's 0.73-goal offense stalls.

goals.comment: Three and two total goals capture 46.4% of the Poisson distribution and align directly with our 2:1 and 2:0 projected match scripts.
